Test: Draft handover for Mom, 19:00 to 23:00. Nothing goes to Mom unless you say so.

- Today so far: 7 feeds, 170 ml from bottles.

Sleep

Today

- Yesterday, feeds came 1 h 27 min apart around 01:37, usually at least 2 h 06 min.

How to reach us

- Ceci: +598 9X XXX XXX.

Health
